versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Image Outpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy.
- Enables extending images beyond their original canvas using the runcomfy CLI, with natural language prompts and aspect ratio changes.
- Automatically routes requests to the best available model or endpoint (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro, or brand-specific edits) based on the outpainting scenario.
- Supports both prose-driven and reference-driven outpainting, with guidance on prompt structure and model selection.
- Includes detailed instructions for CLI usage and links to advanced GUI workflows for complex cases.
